independent_unit: candidate station; bands/acquisitions/5x20 readings are not independent replicates; review spatial overlap before inference

convolution.integration: trapezoidal on union of ASD and SRF knots; linear interpolate only between finite adjacent ASD samples spaced <=1 wavelength unit after nm confirmation
convolution.invalid_policy: reject if nonfinite or missing/noisy interval intersects positive SRF; do not bridge, extrapolate, replace with zero, or silently renormalize truncated bands
convolution.ASD_wavelength_unit: unresolved; coverage diagnostics conditional on nm
convolution.version_sensitivity: v5 separately hashed, normalized SRF diagnostics only; no silent substitution

spatial.support: confirmed field area first; primary containing 10m pixel only when same sampled footprint supported; fixed 3x3 neighborhood sensitivity, never post hoc value optimization
spatial.coarse_bands: B01 native60m, B05/B06/B07/B8A native20m require documented homogeneous footprint of same support; 10m ACOLITE resampling does not create resolution
spatial.registration: grid-aligned B02/B03/B04 with integer crop offset; image-to-ground registration unmeasured; no shifts fitted to ASD reflectance
spatial.resampling: none for primary; area-weighted same-boundary aggregation only under agreed coarse-support contract; nearest neighbor for categorical masks
spatial.time: same day insufficient; record UTC interval and tide/exposure at acquisition and field survey before enabling

masks.support_rule: all primary support pixels must pass common masks; no partial-footprint averaging
masks.acolite_invalid: NaN/nonfinite; no provided l2_flags on March27; l2w_mask=False
masks.defect_masks: native MSK_QUALIT/MSK_DETFOO still require decoding and extraction-stage verification
masks.water: SCL6 not automatically discarded; exposure/optical quantity must be established independently
masks.negative_reflectance: retain finite values after quality masks; flag, do not clip to improve fit

statistics_handoff.status: Thomas to agree contract before extraction
statistics_handoff.common_pairs: identical valid station-band pairs for both methods
statistics_handoff.cluster: station and shared support; retain pixel cluster fields and all exclusion reasons
statistics_handoff.uncertainty: field replicate uncertainty unavailable from mean export; within-target band dependence; few stations; spatial autocorrelation
